caption: P1 sends m1 at (2,0,0); P2 receives it, increments to (2,2,0), and sends m2 at (2,3,0). P3 receives m2 and increments to the final vector (2,3,3), which is larger than (1,0,0).

spec.aria: Three processes exchange two messages; labels show the vector timestamp carried by each message and the final vector at P3.
